name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.zeroLocus_subset_alignmentLocus_left
statement:
theorem zeroLocus_subset_alignmentLocus_left (v w : N) :
    Z.zeroLocus v ⊆ Z.alignmentLocus v w

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.zeroLocus_subset_alignmentLocus_right
statement:
theorem zeroLocus_subset_alignmentLocus_right (v w : N) :
    Z.zeroLocus w ⊆ Z.alignmentLocus v w

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.charge_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem charge_eq_zero_iff {s t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) (v : NumClass) :
    (reZ s t v = 0 ∧ imZ s t v = 0) ↔
      (v.deg = s * v.rk ∧ v.ch2 = ((s ^ 2 + t ^ 2) / 2) * v.rk)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.crossAB_swap
statement:
theorem crossAB_swap (v w₁ w₂ : NumClass) :
    crossAB v w₂ w₁ = -crossAB v w₁ w₂

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.crossAC_swap
statement:
theorem crossAC_swap (v w₁ w₂ : NumClass) :
    crossAC v w₂ w₁ = -crossAC v w₁ w₂

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.crossBC_swap
statement:
theorem crossBC_swap (v w₁ w₂ : NumClass) :
    crossBC v w₂ w₁ = -crossBC v w₁ w₂

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.degV_charge_eq_zero
statement: theorem degV_charge_eq_zero : reZ 0 1 degV = 0 ∧ imZ 0 1 degV = 0

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.eq_of_two_walls
statement:
theorem eq_of_two_walls {s t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) {v w₁ w₂ : NumClass}
    (h₁ : wallExpr s t v w₁ = 0) (h₂ : wallExpr s t v w₂ = 0)
    (hD : minA v w₁ * minB v w₂ - minA v w₂ * minB v w₁ ≠ 0) :
    s = -(minA v w₁ * minC v w₂ - minA v w₂ * minC v w₁)
          / (minA v w₁ * minB v w₂ - minA v w₂ * minB v w₁)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.minA_shift
statement:
@[simp]
theorem minA_shift (k : ℝ) (v w : NumClass) : minA v (shift k v w) = minA v w

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.minB_shift
statement:
@[simp]
theorem minB_shift (k : ℝ) (v w : NumClass) : minB v (shift k v w) = minB v w

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.minC_shift
statement:
@[simp]
theorem minC_shift (k : ℝ) (v w : NumClass) : minC v (shift k v w) = minC v w

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.minorCross_eq_zero_of_two_walls
statement:
theorem minorCross_eq_zero_of_two_walls {s t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) {v w₁ w₂ : NumClass}
    (hv : ¬(reZ s t v = 0 ∧ imZ s t v = 0))
    (h₁ : wallExpr s t v w₁ = 0) (h₂ : wallExpr s t v w₂ = 0) :
    crossAB v w₁ w₂ = 0 ∧ crossAC v w₁ w₂ = 0 ∧ crossBC v w₁ w₂ = 0

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.minor_orth
statement:
theorem minor_orth (v w : NumClass) :
    v.ch2 * minA v w + v.deg * minB v w + v.rk * minC v w = 0

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.wallExpr_eq
statement:
theorem wallExpr_eq (s t : ℝ) (v w : NumClass) :
    wallExpr s t v w
      = t * (minC v w + s * minB v w + ((s ^ 2 + t ^ 2) / 2) * minA v w)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.wallExpr_shift
statement:
theorem wallExpr_shift (s t k : ℝ) (v w : NumClass) :
    wallExpr s t v (shift k v w) = wallExpr s t v w

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.wall_circle_eq
statement:
theorem wall_circle_eq {s t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) {v w : NumClass}
    (hA : minA v w ≠ 0) :
    wallExpr s t v w = 0 ↔
      (minA v w * s + minB v w) ^ 2 + (minA v w * t) ^ 2
        = minB v w ^ 2 - 2 * minA v w * minC v w

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.wall_eq_of_meet
statement:
theorem wall_eq_of_meet {s t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) {v w₁ w₂ : NumClass}
    (hv : ¬(reZ s t v = 0 ∧ imZ s t v = 0))
    (h₁ : wallExpr s t v w₁ = 0) (h₂ : wallExpr s t v w₂ = 0)
    (hn₁ : ¬(minA v w₁ = 0 ∧ minB v w₁ = 0 ∧ minC v w₁ = 0))
    (hn₂ : ¬(minA v w₂ = 0 ∧ minB v w₂ = 0 ∧ minC v w₂ = 0))
    {s' t' : ℝ} (ht' : t' ≠ 0) :
    wallExpr s' t' v w₁ = 0 ↔ wallExpr s' t' v w₂ = 0

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.wall_eq_of_meet_needs_charge
statement:
theorem wall_eq_of_meet_needs_charge :
    ∃ w₁ w₂ : NumClass,
      wallExpr 0 1 degV w₁ = 0 ∧ wallExpr 0 1 degV w₂ = 0 ∧
      ¬(minA degV w₁ = 0 ∧ minB degV w₁ = 0 ∧ minC degV w₁ = 0) ∧
      ¬(minA degV w₂ = 0 ∧ minB degV w₂ = 0 ∧ minC degV w₂ = 0) ∧
      wallExpr 0 2 degV w₂ = 0 ∧ wallExpr 0 2 degV w₁ ≠ 0

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.wall_iff_circle
statement:
theorem wall_iff_circle {s t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) (v w : NumClass) :
    wallExpr s t v w = 0 ↔
      minA v w * (s ^ 2 + t ^ 2) + 2 * minB v w * s + 2 * minC v w = 0

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.wall_line_eq
CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.wall_subset_of_crossZero
statement:
theorem wall_subset_of_crossZero {v w₁ w₂ : NumClass}
    (hAB : crossAB v w₁ w₂ = 0) (hAC : crossAC v w₁ w₂ = 0) (hBC : crossBC v w₁ w₂ = 0)
    (hn : ¬(minA v w₁ = 0 ∧ minB v w₁ = 0 ∧ minC v w₁ = 0))
    {s t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) (h : wallExpr s t v w₁ = 0) :
    wallExpr s t v w₂ = 0

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.mem_stChargeFamily_alignmentLocus
statement:
theorem mem_stChargeFamily_alignmentLocus (p : ℝ × ℝ) (v w : NumClass) :
    p ∈ stChargeFamily.alignmentLocus v w ↔ wallExpr p.1 p.2 v w = 0

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.stChargeFamily_alignmentValue
statement:
@[simp]
theorem stChargeFamily_alignmentValue (p : ℝ × ℝ) (v w : NumClass) :
    stChargeFamily.alignmentValue p v w = wallExpr p.1 p.2 v w

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.NumClass.discr_eq
statement: theorem discr_eq (v : NumClass) : v.discr = v.deg ^ 2 - 2 * v.rk * v.ch2

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.NumClass.discr_eq_selfPairing
statement:
theorem discr_eq_selfPairing (v : NumClass) :
    v.discr = Mukai.selfPairing (LinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) v

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.NumClass.discr_of_rk_eq_zero
statement: theorem discr_of_rk_eq_zero {v : NumClass} (h : v.rk = 0) : v.discr = v.deg ^ 2

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.NumClass.discr_scale
statement: theorem discr_scale (c : ℝ) (v : NumClass) : (scale c v).discr = c ^ 2 * v.discr

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.NumClass.scale_ch2
statement:
@[simp]
theorem scale_ch2 (c : ℝ) (v : NumClass) : (scale c v).ch2 = c * v.ch2

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.NumClass.scale_deg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem scale_deg (c : ℝ) (v : NumClass) : (scale c v).deg = c * v.deg

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.NumClass.scale_rk
statement:

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.nested_of_offsets
statement:
theorem nested_of_offsets {a₁ a₂ k : ℝ} (hk0 : 0 ≤ k)
    (h₁ : k ≤ a₁ ^ 2) (h₂ : k ≤ a₂ ^ 2) (hfam : 0 < a₁ * a₂) :
    (a₂ - a₁) ^ 2 ≤ (a₁ ^ 2 - k) + (a₂ ^ 2 - k) ∧
      4 * (a₁ ^ 2 - k) * (a₂ ^ 2 - k) ≤
        ((a₂ - a₁) ^ 2 - (a₁ ^ 2 - k) - (a₂ ^ 2 - k)) ^ 2

statement:
theorem nesting_identity (a₁ a₂ k : ℝ) :

theorem wallCentre_eq (v w : NumClass) : wallCentre v w = -(minB v w) / minA v w

statement:
theorem wallCentre_eq_sub_offset (v w : NumClass) :

statement:
@[simp]
theorem wallRadiusSq_eq (v w : NumClass) :
    wallRadiusSq v w = (minB v w ^ 2 - 2 * minA v w * minC v w) / minA v w ^ 2

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.wallRadiusSq_eq_offset
statement:
theorem wallRadiusSq_eq_offset {v w : NumClass} (hrk : v.rk ≠ 0) (hA : minA v w ≠ 0) :
    wallRadiusSq v w = wallOffset v w ^ 2 - v.discr / v.rk ^ 2

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.walls_nested_of_discr_nonneg
statement:
theorem walls_nested_of_discr_nonneg {v w₁ w₂ : NumClass}
    (hrk : v.rk ≠ 0) (hdisc : 0 ≤ v.discr)
    (hA₁ : minA v w₁ ≠ 0) (hA₂ : minA v w₂ ≠ 0)
    (hR₁ : 0 ≤ wallRadiusSq v w₁) (hR₂ : 0 ≤ wallRadiusSq v w₂)
    (hfam : 0 < wallOffset v w₁ * wallOffset v w₂) :
    (wallCentre v w₁ - wallCentre v w₂) ^ 2 ≤ wallRadiusSq v w₁ + wallRadiusSq v w₂ ∧
      4 * wallRadiusSq v w₁ * wallRadiusSq v w₂ ≤
        ((wallCentre v w₁ - wallCentre v w₂) ^ 2
          - wallRadiusSq v w₁ - wallRadiusSq v w₂) ^ 2

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.walls_not_nested_of_opposite_offset
statement:
theorem walls_not_nested_of_opposite_offset :
    ∃ v w₁ w₂ : NumClass,
      v.rk ≠ 0 ∧ 0 ≤ v.discr ∧ minA v w₁ ≠ 0 ∧ minA v w₂ ≠ 0 ∧
      0 ≤ wallRadiusSq v w₁ ∧ 0 ≤ wallRadiusSq v w₂ ∧
      wallOffset v w₁ * wallOffset v w₂ < 0 ∧
      ¬((wallCentre v w₁ - wallCentre v w₂) ^ 2
        ≤ wallRadiusSq v w₁ + wallRadiusSq v w₂)

statement:
theorem wall_eq_of_meet_of_semistable {E : N} (B : BogomolovGiesekerData V P)

    {s t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) {w₁ w₂ : Wall.NumClass}
    (h₁ : Wall.wallExpr s t (toNumClass V P E) w₁ = 0)
    (h₂ : Wall.wallExpr s t (toNumClass V P E) w₂ = 0)
    (hn₁ : ¬(Wall.minA (toNumClass V P E) w₁ = 0 ∧ Wall.minB (toNumClass V P E) w₁ = 0
      ∧ Wall.minC (toNumClass V P E) w₁ = 0))
    (hn₂ : ¬(Wall.minA (toNumClass V P E) w₂ = 0 ∧ Wall.minB (toNumClass V P E) w₂ = 0
      ∧ Wall.minC (toNumClass V P E) w₂ = 0))
    {s' t' : ℝ} (ht' : t' ≠ 0) :
    Wall.wallExpr s' t' (toNumClass V P E) w₁ = 0
      ↔ Wall.wallExpr s' t' (toNumClass V P E) w₂ = 0

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.walls_nested_of_semistable
statement:
theorem walls_nested_of_semistable {E : N} (B : BogomolovGiesekerData V P)
    (hI : HodgeIndexStatement V P) (hE : B.Semistable E)
    (hrk : (toNumClass V P E).rk ≠ 0) {w₁ w₂ : Wall.NumClass}
    (hA₁ : Wall.minA (toNumClass V P E) w₁ ≠ 0)
    (hA₂ : Wall.minA (toNumClass V P E) w₂ ≠ 0)
    (hR₁ : 0 ≤ Wall.wallRadiusSq (toNumClass V P E) w₁)
    (hR₂ : 0 ≤ Wall.wallRadiusSq (toNumClass V P E) w₂)
    (hfam : 0 < Wall.wallOffset (toNumClass V P E) w₁
      * Wall.wallOffset (toNumClass V P E) w₂) :
    (Wall.wallCentre (toNumClass V P E) w₁
          - Wall.wallCentre (toNumClass V P E) w₂) ^ 2
        ≤ Wall.wallRadiusSq (toNumClass V P E) w₁
          + Wall.wallRadiusSq (toNumClass V P E) w₂ ∧
      4 * Wall.wallRadiusSq (toNumClass V P E) w₁
          * Wall.wallRadiusSq (toNumClass V P E) w₂
        ≤ ((Wall.wallCentre (toNumClass V P E) w₁
              - Wall.wallCentre (toNumClass V P E) w₂) ^ 2
          - Wall.wallRadiusSq (toNumClass V P E) w₁
          - Wall.wallRadiusSq (toNumClass V P E) w₂) ^ 2

name: Mukai.expCharge_apply
statement:
theorem expCharge_apply (hb : ∀ x y : V, b x y = b y x) (r : ℝ) (c : V) (s : ℝ) :
    expCharge b β ω (r, c, s)
      = Complex.ofReal (b β c - s - r * (b β β - b ω ω) / 2)
        + Complex.ofReal (b ω c - r * b β ω) * Complex.I

statement:
@[simp]
theorem mukaiCharge_apply (t : SqrtTodd D) (P : StabilityParameters D) (E : N) :
    ch.mukaiCharge S t P E =
      Mukai.expCharge S.intersection P.B P.omega (ch.mukaiVector S t E)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChernCharacter.mukaiCharge_eq_centralCharge_add
statement:
theorem mukaiCharge_eq_centralCharge_add (t : SqrtTodd D) (P : StabilityParameters D)
    (E : N) :
    ch.mukaiCharge S t P E =
      ch.centralCharge S P E
        + Complex.ofReal (ch.rank E * S.pair P.B t.divisor
            - S.pair t.divisor (ch.chOne E) - ch.rank E * t.number)
        + Complex.I * Complex.ofReal (ch.rank E * S.pair P.omega t.divisor)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChernCharacter.mukaiCharge_k3
statement:
theorem mukaiCharge_k3 (P : StabilityParameters D) (E : N) :
    ch.mukaiCharge S SqrtTodd.k3 P E =

statement:
theorem mukaiCharge_trivial (P : StabilityParameters D) (E : N) :

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChernCharacter.mukaiVector_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mukaiVector_apply (t : SqrtTodd D) (E : N) :
    ch.mukaiVector S t E =
      (ch.rank E, ch.chOne E + ch.rank E • t.divisor,
        ch.chTwo E + S.pair t.divisor (ch.chOne E) + ch.rank E * t.number)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChernCharacter.mukaiVector_k3

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.DivisorSpace.realCentralCharge_apply
statement:
theorem realCentralCharge_apply (P : StabilityParameters D) (r : ℝ) (c : D) (s : ℝ) :
    S.realCentralCharge P (r, c, s) =
      Complex.ofReal (S.pair P.B c - s - r * (S.pair P.B P.B - S.pair P.omega P.omega) / 2)
        + Complex.ofReal (S.pair P.omega c - r * S.pair P.B P.omega) * Complex.I

    (v : Mukai.RealExtension D) :
    S.realDiscriminantC P C v =
      S.realDiscriminant v + C * S.omegaTwistedDegree P v ^ 2

statement:
theorem realDiscriminantC_neg_of_charge_eq_zero (P : StabilityParameters D)
    (hω : S.HodgeDefinite P.omega) (C : ℝ) {v : Mukai.RealExtension D}

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.DivisorSpace.realDiscriminantC_of_charge_eq_zero
statement:
theorem realDiscriminantC_of_charge_eq_zero (P : StabilityParameters D) (C : ℝ)
    {v : Mukai.RealExtension D} (hZ : S.realCentralCharge P v = 0) :
    S.realDiscriminantC P C v =
      S.pair (v.2.1 - v.1 • P.B) (v.2.1 - v.1 • P.B) - v.1 ^ 2 * S.pair P.omega P.omega

statement:
theorem exists_uniform_coercivity (hsig : HasSignatureTwo Q) {S : Set (M × M)}
    (hS : IsCompact S)
    (hpos : ∀ p ∈ S, IsPositivePlane Q (Submodule.span ℝ ({p.1, p.2} : Set M))) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ p ∈ S, ∀ u ∈ orthogonal Q (Submodule.span ℝ ({p.1, p.2} : Set M)),
      c * ‖u‖ ^ 2 ≤ -Q u

    (f : N →ₗ[ℤ] V) (hf : ∀ x y : N, bR (f x) (f y) = (bZ x y : ℝ))
    (hb : ∀ x y : V, bR x y = bR y x) {δ : MukaiLattice N} (hδ : IsSpherical bZ δ) :
    PeriodDomain.IsSphericalClass (realForm bR) (extendMap f δ)

CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.DivisorSpace.expPairMap_fst

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.DivisorSpace.finite_walls_meeting_expFamily
statement:
theorem finite_walls_meeting_expFamily (h : S.HodgeDefinite H) {K : Set (D × D)}

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Spherical.IntegralComparison.map_fst

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Spherical.chartIm_eq
statement: theorem chartIm_eq (β ω : V) : chartIm q β ω = (0, ω, q β ω)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Spherical.chartRe_eq
statement: theorem chartRe_eq (β ω : V) : chartRe q β ω = (1, β, (q β β - q ω ω) / 2)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Spherical.corank_eq_of_isSpherical
statement:
theorem corank_eq_of_isSpherical {δ : Mukai.RealExtension V} (hs : IsSpherical q δ)
    (hr : δ.1 ≠ 0) :
    δ.2.2 = (q δ.2.1 δ.2.1 + 2) / (2 * δ.1)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Spherical.isSpherical_iff
statement:
theorem isSpherical_iff (δ : Mukai.RealExtension V) :
    IsSpherical q δ ↔ selfPairing q δ = -2

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Spherical.isSpherical_map_iff
statement:
theorem isSpherical_map_iff (c : IntegralComparison q b)
    (v : Mukai.MukaiLattice N) :
    IsSpherical q (c.map v) ↔ Mukai.IsSpherical b v

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Spherical.isSpherical_of_mem_sphericalPlus
statement:
theorem isSpherical_of_mem_sphericalPlus {δ : Mukai.RealExtension V}
    (h : δ ∈ sphericalPlus q) : IsSpherical q δ

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Spherical.mem_nonpositiveRayLocus_iff
statement:
theorem mem_nonpositiveRayLocus_iff (δ : Mukai.RealExtension V) (p : V × V) :
    p ∈ nonpositiveRayLocus q δ ↔ pairingIm q p.1 p.2 δ = 0 ∧ pairingRe q p.1 p.2 δ ≤ 0

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Spherical.mem_nonpositiveRayLocus_iff_of_isSpherical
statement:
theorem mem_nonpositiveRayLocus_iff_of_isSpherical (hq : ∀ x y : V, q x y = q y x)
    {δ : Mukai.RealExtension V} (hs : IsSpherical q δ) (hr : 0 < δ.1) (p : V × V) :
    p ∈ nonpositiveRayLocus q δ ↔
      q (δ.2.1 - δ.1 • p.1) p.2 = 0 ∧
        δ.1 ^ 2 * q p.2 p.2
          ≤ 2 + q (δ.2.1 - δ.1 • p.1) (δ.2.1 - δ.1 • p.1)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Spherical.mem_signedRayRegularLocus_iff
statement:
theorem mem_signedRayRegularLocus_iff (S : Set (Mukai.RealExtension V)) (p : V × V) :
    p ∈ signedRayRegularLocus q S ↔ ∀ δ ∈ S, p ∉ nonpositiveRayLocus q δ

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Spherical.mem_sphericalPlus_iff
statement:
theorem mem_sphericalPlus_iff (δ : Mukai.RealExtension V) :
    δ ∈ sphericalPlus q ↔ IsSpherical q δ ∧ 0 < δ.1

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Spherical.pairingIm_eq
statement:
theorem pairingIm_eq (β ω : V) (δ : Mukai.RealExtension V) :
    pairingIm q β ω δ = q ω δ.2.1 - δ.1 * q β ω

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Spherical.pairingIm_eq_of_symm
statement:
theorem pairingIm_eq_of_symm (hq : ∀ x y : V, q x y = q y x) (β ω : V)
    (δ : Mukai.RealExtension V) :
    pairingIm q β ω δ = q (δ.2.1 - δ.1 • β) ω

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Spherical.pairingRe_eq
statement:
theorem pairingRe_eq (β ω : V) (δ : Mukai.RealExtension V) :
    pairingRe q β ω δ = q β δ.2.1 - δ.2.2 - δ.1 * ((q β β - q ω ω) / 2)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Spherical.pairingRe_eq_of_rk_ne_zero
statement:
theorem pairingRe_eq_of_rk_ne_zero (hq : ∀ x y : V, q x y = q y x) (β ω : V)
    {δ : Mukai.RealExtension V} (hr : δ.1 ≠ 0) :
    pairingRe q β ω δ
      = (selfPairing q δ + δ.1 ^ 2 * q ω ω
          - q (δ.2.1 - δ.1 • β) (δ.2.1 - δ.1 • β)) / (2 * δ.1)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Spherical.pairingRe_of_rk_eq_zero
statement:
theorem pairingRe_of_rk_eq_zero (β ω : V) {δ : Mukai.RealExtension V} (hr : δ.1 = 0) :
    pairingRe q β ω δ = q β δ.2.1 - δ.2.2

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Spherical.pairing_map
statement:
theorem pairing_map (c : IntegralComparison q b) (v w : Mukai.MukaiLattice N) :
    pairing q (c.map v) (c.map w) = ((Mukai.pairing b v w : ℤ) : ℝ)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Spherical.pairing_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pairing_mk (r : ℝ) (c : V) (s : ℝ) (r' : ℝ) (c' : V) (s' : ℝ) :
    pairing q (r, c, s) (r', c', s') = q c c' - r * s' - r' * s

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Spherical.rk_pos_of_mem_sphericalPlus
statement:
theorem rk_pos_of_mem_sphericalPlus {δ : Mukai.RealExtension V}
    (h : δ ∈ sphericalPlus q) : 0 < δ.1

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Spherical.selfPairing_eq_pairing
statement:
theorem selfPairing_eq_pairing (v : Mukai.RealExtension V) :
    selfPairing q v = pairing q v v

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Spherical.selfPairing_map
statement:
theorem selfPairing_map (c : IntegralComparison q b) (v : Mukai.MukaiLattice N) :
    selfPairing q (c.map v) = ((Mukai.selfPairing b v : ℤ) : ℝ)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Spherical.selfPairing_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem selfPairing_mk (r : ℝ) (c : V) (s : ℝ) :
    selfPairing q (r, c, s) = q c c - 2 * (r * s)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Spherical.signedRayRegularLocus_antitone
statement:
theorem signedRayRegularLocus_antitone {S T : Set (Mukai.RealExtension V)} (h : S ⊆ T) :

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Spherical.signedRayRegularLocus_eq_compl_iUnion
statement:
theorem signedRayRegularLocus_eq_compl_iUnion (S : Set (Mukai.RealExtension V)) :
    signedRayRegularLocus q S = (⋃ δ ∈ S, nonpositiveRayLocus q δ)ᶜ

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Spherical.two_mul_rk_mul_pairingRe
statement:
theorem two_mul_rk_mul_pairingRe (hq : ∀ x y : V, q x y = q y x) (β ω : V)
    (δ : Mukai.RealExtension V) :
    2 * δ.1 * pairingRe q β ω δ
      = selfPairing q δ + δ.1 ^ 2 * q ω ω
        - q (δ.2.1 - δ.1 • β) (δ.2.1 - δ.1 • β)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Spherical.two_mul_rk_mul_pairingRe_of_rk_eq_zero
statement:
theorem two_mul_rk_mul_pairingRe_of_rk_eq_zero (hq : ∀ x y : V, q x y = q y x)
    (β ω : V) {δ : Mukai.RealExtension V} (hr : δ.1 = 0) :
    2 * δ.1 * pairingRe q β ω δ = 0 ∧
      selfPairing q δ + δ.1 ^ 2 * q ω ω
        - q (δ.2.1 - δ.1 • β) (δ.2.1 - δ.1 • β) = 0

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Spherical.BoundedRegion.exists_norm_fst_le
statement: theorem exists_norm_fst_le : ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ p ∈ R.carrier, ‖p.1‖ ≤ M

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Spherical.BoundedRegion.finite_rayCandidates
statement:
theorem finite_rayCandidates (hq : ∀ x y : V, q x y = q y x)
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ V] {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (basis : Module.Basis ι ℝ V) :
    (rayCandidates q R ↑(Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range basis))).Finite

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Spherical.BoundedRegion.key
statement:
theorem key (hq : ∀ x y : V, q x y = q y x) {δ : Mukai.RealExtension V}
    (hs : IsSpherical q δ) (hr : 0 < δ.1) {p : V × V} (hp : p ∈ R.carrier)
    (hw : p ∈ nonpositiveRayLocus q δ) :
    q (δ.2.1 - δ.1 • p.1) (δ.2.1 - δ.1 • p.1) ≤ -R.coercivity * ‖δ.2.1 - δ.1 • p.1‖ ^ 2 ∧
      δ.1 ^ 2 * q p.2 p.2
        ≤ 2 + q (δ.2.1 - δ.1 • p.1) (δ.2.1 - δ.1 • p.1)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Spherical.BoundedRegion.normSq_sub_smul_le
statement:
theorem normSq_sub_smul_le (hq : ∀ x y : V, q x y = q y x) {δ : Mukai.RealExtension V}
    (hs : IsSpherical q δ) (hr : 0 < δ.1) {p : V × V} (hp : p ∈ R.carrier)
    (hw : p ∈ nonpositiveRayLocus q δ) :
    ‖δ.2.1 - δ.1 • p.1‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 / R.coercivity

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Spherical.BoundedRegion.rayCandidates_subset
statement:
theorem rayCandidates_subset (hq : ∀ x y : V, q x y = q y x) (Λ : Set V)
    {M : ℝ} (hM : ∀ p ∈ R.carrier, ‖p.1‖ ≤ M) :
    rayCandidates q R Λ ⊆
      reconstruct q ''
        (Set.Icc (1 : ℤ) ⌈2 / R.ampleLower⌉ ×ˢ
          (Metric.closedBall (0 : V)
            (Real.sqrt (2 / R.coercivity) +
              Real.sqrt (2 / R.ampleLower) * M) ∩ Λ))

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Spherical.BoundedRegion.rk_sq_le
statement:
theorem rk_sq_le (hq : ∀ x y : V, q x y = q y x) {δ : Mukai.RealExtension V}
    (hs : IsSpherical q δ) (hr : 0 < δ.1) {p : V × V} (hp : p ∈ R.carrier)
    (hw : p ∈ nonpositiveRayLocus q δ) :
    δ.1 ^ 2 ≤ 2 / R.ampleLower

CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Spherical.mem_chartPlane_orthogonalityLocus_iff

statement:

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.OrthogonalSlice.alignmentLocus_ofST_circle_eq
statement:
theorem alignmentLocus_ofST_circle_eq (ch : ChernCharacter N D) (uu : U) {p : ℝ × ℝ}
    (ht : p.2 ≠ 0) {v w : N}
    (hA : Wall.minA ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass v)
      ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass w) ≠ 0) :
    Point.ofST uu p ∈ T.alignmentLocus ch v w ↔
      (Wall.minA ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass v)
              ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass w) * p.1
            + Wall.minB ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass v)
              ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass w)) ^ 2
          + (Wall.minA ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass v)
              ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass w) * p.2) ^ 2
        = Wall.minB ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass v)
              ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass w) ^ 2
          - 2 * Wall.minA ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass v)
              ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass w)
            * Wall.minC ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass v)
              ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass w)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.OrthogonalSlice.alignmentLocus_ofST_iff_circle
statement:
theorem alignmentLocus_ofST_iff_circle (ch : ChernCharacter N D) (uu : U) {p : ℝ × ℝ}
    (ht : p.2 ≠ 0) (v w : N) :
    Point.ofST uu p ∈ T.alignmentLocus ch v w ↔
      Wall.minA ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass v)
            ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass w) * (p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2)
          + 2 * Wall.minB ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass v)
            ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass w) * p.1
          + 2 * Wall.minC ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass v)
            ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass w) = 0

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.OrthogonalSlice.alignmentLocus_ofST_line_eq
statement:
theorem alignmentLocus_ofST_line_eq (ch : ChernCharacter N D) (uu : U) {p : ℝ × ℝ}
    (ht : p.2 ≠ 0) {v w : N}
    (hA : Wall.minA ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass v)
      ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass w) = 0)
    (hB : Wall.minB ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass v)
      ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass w) ≠ 0) :
    Point.ofST uu p ∈ T.alignmentLocus ch v w ↔
      p.1 = -(Wall.minC ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass v)
          ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass w))
        / Wall.minB ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass v)
          ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass w)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.OrthogonalSlice.discr_sliceCoordinates
statement:
theorem discr_sliceCoordinates (ch : ChernCharacter N D) (uu : U) (E : N) :
    (T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).discr E =
      S.pair T.H (ch.chOne E) ^ 2
        - 2 * S.pair T.H T.H * ch.rank E * ch.chTwo E
        + 2 * S.pair T.H T.H * ch.rank E * S.pair (T.transverse uu) (ch.chOne E)
        - S.pair T.H T.H * ch.rank E ^ 2
          * S.pair (T.transverse uu) (T.transverse uu)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.FourierMukai.ConvolutionData.transformK₀_conv
statement:
theorem transformK₀_conv {C₁ : Correspondence 𝒳 𝒴 𝒲₁}
    {C₂ : Correspondence 𝒴 𝒵 𝒲₂} {C₃ : Correspondence 𝒳 𝒵 𝒲₃}
    (D : ConvolutionData C₁ C₂ C₃) (P : 𝒲₁) (Q : 𝒲₂)
    [C₁.pull.CommShift ℤ] [(C₁.tensor.obj P).CommShift ℤ] [C₁.push.CommShift ℤ]
    [C₁.pull.IsTriangulated] [(C₁.tensor.obj P).IsTriangulated]
    [C₁.push.IsTriangulated]
    [C₂.pull.CommShift ℤ] [(C₂.tensor.obj Q).CommShift ℤ] [C₂.push.CommShift ℤ]
    [C₂.pull.IsTriangulated] [(C₂.tensor.obj Q).IsTriangulated]
    [C₂.push.IsTriangulated]
    [C₃.pull.CommShift ℤ] [(C₃.tensor.obj (D.conv P Q)).CommShift ℤ]
    [C₃.push.CommShift ℤ] [C₃.pull.IsTriangulated]
    [(C₃.tensor.obj (D.conv P Q)).IsTriangulated] [C₃.push.IsTriangulated] :
    C₃.transformK₀ (D.conv P Q) =
      (C₂.transformK₀ Q).comp (C₁.transformK₀ P)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.FourierMukai.Correspondence.K₀_map_eq_transformK₀
statement:
theorem K₀_map_eq_transformK₀ (C : Correspondence 𝒳 𝒴 𝒲) (K : 𝒲)

theorem isSpherical_mukaiVector_iff_of_preservesEuler (D : IntegralMukaiData V Λ)

    [C.pull.CommShift ℤ] [(C.tensor.obj K).CommShift ℤ] [C.push.CommShift ℤ]

    [C.push.IsTriangulated]
    (R : K₀.Realization 𝒳 N) (R' : K₀.Realization 𝒴 N')

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.pairing_mukaiVector_eq_of_preservesEuler

theorem pairing_mukaiVector_eq_on_realized (C : Correspondence 𝒳 𝒴 𝒲) (K : 𝒲)

statement:
theorem chi₂_eq_mukaiIntegral (hK3 : IsK3 V) (E F : N) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.mukaiClass_eq
statement:
theorem mukaiClass_eq (E : N) :
    V.mukaiClass E = V.mukaiComp E 0 + V.mukaiComp E 1 + V.mukaiComp E 2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.mukaiDual_eq
statement:
theorem mukaiDual_eq (E : N) :
    V.mukaiDual E = V.mukaiComp E 0 - V.mukaiComp E 1 + V.mukaiComp E 2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.mukaiIntegral_comm
statement:
theorem mukaiIntegral_comm (hK3 : IsK3 V) (E F : N) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.mukaiIntegral_eq
statement:
theorem mukaiIntegral_eq (hK3 : IsK3 V) (E F : N) :
    mukaiIntegral V E F =
      (V.rank E : ℚ) * mukaiS V F - V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 1 * V.chComp F 1)
        + (V.rank F : ℚ) * mukaiS V E

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.mukaiIntegral_eq_neg_mukaiPairing
statement:
theorem mukaiIntegral_eq_neg_mukaiPairing (hK3 : IsK3 V) (E F : N) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.mukaiIntegral_self
statement:
theorem mukaiIntegral_self (hK3 : IsK3 V) (E : N) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.mukaiIntegral_self_eq
statement:
theorem mukaiIntegral_self_eq (hK3 : IsK3 V) (E : N) :
    mukaiIntegral V E E = 2 * (V.rank E : ℚ) ^ 2 - V.ring.degree (V.discriminant E)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.pairing_eq_neg_mukaiIntegral

theorem pairing_eq_neg_mukaiIntegral (hHRR : V.SatisfiesHRR) (hK3 : IsK3 V) (E F : N) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.CalabiYauFourfold.chi_eq
statement:
theorem chi_eq (hHRR : V.SatisfiesHRR) (hCY : IsCalabiYau V) (E : N) :
    (V.chi E : ℚ)
      = 2 * (V.rank E : ℚ)
        + V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 2 * V.toddComp 2)
        + V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 4)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Fourfold.chi_eq
statement:
theorem chi_eq (hV : V.SatisfiesHRR) (E : N) :
    (V.chi E : ℚ)
      = (V.rank E : ℚ) * V.ring.degree (V.toddComp 4)
        + V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 1 * V.toddComp 3)
        + V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 2 * V.toddComp 2)
        + V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 3 * V.toddComp 1)
        + V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 4)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.CalabiYauThreefold.chi_eq
statement:
theorem chi_eq (hHRR : V.SatisfiesHRR) (hCY : IsCalabiYau V) (E : N) :
    (V.chi E : ℚ)
      = V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 1 * V.toddComp 2)
        + V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 3)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.CalabiYauThreefold.chi_eq_of_chComp_eq
statement:
theorem chi_eq_of_chComp_eq (E F : N)
    (hHRR : V.SatisfiesHRR) (hCY : IsCalabiYau V)
    (h₁ : V.chComp E 1 = V.chComp F 1)
    (h₃ : V.chComp E 3 = V.chComp F 3) :
    (V.chi E : ℚ) = (V.chi F : ℚ)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.chi_eq
statement:
theorem chi_eq (hV : V.SatisfiesHRR) (E : N) :
    (V.chi E : ℚ)
      = (V.rank E : ℚ) * V.ring.degree (V.toddComp 3)
        + V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 1 * V.toddComp 2)
        + V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 2 * V.toddComp 1)
        + V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 3)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.Q_zero_alpha
statement:
theorem Q_zero_alpha (β : ℚ) (E : N) :
    Q V P 0 β E
      = 4 * (degH2Beta V P β E) ^ 2 - 6 * (degH1Beta V P β E) * (deg3Beta V P β E)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.Q_zero_beta
statement:
theorem Q_zero_beta (α : ℚ) (E : N) :
    Q V P α 0 E
      = α ^ 2 * ((V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 1 * P.cls ^ 2)) ^ 2
          - 2 * (V.ring.degree (P.cls ^ 3) * (V.rank E : ℚ))
            * V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 2 * P.cls))
        + 4 * (V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 2 * P.cls)) ^ 2
        - 6 * (V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 1 * P.cls ^ 2))
          * V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 3)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.deg3Beta_zero_beta
statement:
@[simp]
theorem deg3Beta_zero_beta (E : N) :
    deg3Beta V P 0 E = V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 3)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.degH1Beta_eq_sub
statement:
theorem degH1Beta_eq_sub (β : ℚ) (E : N) :
    degH1Beta V P β E
      = degH1Beta V P 0 E - β * (V.ring.degree (P.cls ^ 3) * (V.rank E : ℚ))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.degH1Beta_zero_beta
statement:
@[simp]
theorem degH1Beta_zero_beta (E : N) :
    degH1Beta V P 0 E = V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 1 * P.cls ^ 2)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.degH2Beta_eq_sub
statement:
theorem degH2Beta_eq_sub (β : ℚ) (E : N) :
    degH2Beta V P β E
      = degH2Beta V P 0 E - β * degH1Beta V P 0 E
        + β ^ 2 / 2 * (V.ring.degree (P.cls ^ 3) * (V.rank E : ℚ))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.degH2Beta_zero_beta
statement:
@[simp]
theorem degH2Beta_zero_beta (E : N) :
    degH2Beta V P 0 E = V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 2 * P.cls)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.discrHBeta_beta_inert
statement:
theorem discrHBeta_beta_inert (β : ℚ) (E : N) :
    (degH1Beta V P β E) ^ 2
        - 2 * (V.ring.degree (P.cls ^ 3) * (V.rank E : ℚ)) * (degH2Beta V P β E)
      = discrHBeta V P E

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.discrHBeta_eq_selfPairing
statement:
theorem discrHBeta_eq_selfPairing (E : N) :
    discrHBeta V P E
      = Mukai.selfPairing (LinearMap.mul ℚ ℚ)
          (V.ring.degree (P.cls ^ 3) * (V.rank E : ℚ), degH1Beta V P 0 E,
            degH2Beta V P 0 E)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.discrHBeta_zero_beta
statement:
theorem discrHBeta_zero_beta (E : N) :
    discrHBeta V P E
      = (V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 1 * P.cls ^ 2)) ^ 2
        - 2 * (V.ring.degree (P.cls ^ 3) * (V.rank E : ℚ))
          * V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 2 * P.cls)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.nu_zero_alpha
statement:
theorem nu_zero_alpha (β : ℚ) (E : N) :
    nu V P 0 β E = degH2Beta V P β E / degH1Beta V P β E

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.NumericalRealization.pair_extendDivisorClass
statement:

theorem charge_twist (m : ℕ) (w : ℂ) (β : ℝ) (d : HDeg m) :

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Exp.twist_apply
statement:
theorem twist_apply (m : ℕ) (β : ℝ) (d : HDeg m) (i : Fin (m + 1)) :
    twist m β d i = ∑ j : Fin (i.val + 1),
      (-β) ^ (i.val - j.val) / ((i.val - j.val).factorial : ℝ) *
        d ⟨j.val, by have := j.isLt; have := i.isLt; omega⟩

statement:
theorem twist_twist (m : ℕ) (β γ : ℝ) (d : HDeg m) :

statement: @[simp] theorem twist_zero (m : ℕ) (d : HDeg m) : twist m 0 d = d

    (c : ℕ → A) (m : ℕ) (hmn : m ≤ n) :
    (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => (R.degree (twist H β c i * H ^ (n - i.val)) : ℝ)) =
      Exp.twist m (β : ℝ)
        (fun i => (R.degree (c i * H ^ (n - i.val)) : ℝ))

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Threefold.betaTwist_deg2
statement:

    (betaTwist β v).deg2 = v.deg2 - β * v.deg1 + β ^ 2 / 2 * v.deg0

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Threefold.betaTwist_deg3
statement:
@[simp] theorem betaTwist_deg3 (β : ℝ) (v : NumClass) :
    (betaTwist β v).deg3 =
      v.deg3 - β * v.deg2 + β ^ 2 / 2 * v.deg1 - β ^ 3 / 6 * v.deg0

statement:
theorem ChargeCoordinates.twistByScalar_eq_exp (D : ChargeCoordinates N) (β : ℝ) (E : N) :
    ![(D.twistByScalar β).hyperplaneSquare * (D.twistByScalar β).rank E,
      (D.twistByScalar β).degree E, (D.twistByScalar β).chTwo E] =
      Exp.twist 2 β ![D.hyperplaneSquare * D.rank E, D.degree E, D.chTwo E]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChernCharacter.twist_rankOne_eq_exp
statement:
theorem ChernCharacter.twist_rankOne_eq_exp (ch : ChernCharacter N D)
    (S : DivisorSpace D) (H : D) (β : ℝ) (E : N) :
    ![S.pair H H * (ch.twist S (β • H)).rank E,
      S.pair H ((ch.twist S (β • H)).chOne E), (ch.twist S (β • H)).chTwo E] =
      Exp.twist 2 β ![S.pair H H * ch.rank E, S.pair H (ch.chOne E), ch.chTwo E]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.centralCharge_eq_expCharge

      = Mukai.expCharge S.intersection P.B P.omega (ch.toRealExtension E)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.centralCharge_rankOne_eq_charge
statement:
theorem centralCharge_rankOne_eq_charge (ch : ChernCharacter N D) (S : DivisorSpace D)
    (H : D) (a b : ℝ) (E : N) :
    ch.centralCharge S (StabilityParameters.rankOne H a b) E
      = Exp.charge 2 (Exp.alphaBetaChart (a, b))
          ![S.pair H H * ch.rank E, S.pair H (ch.chOne E), ch.chTwo E]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.expCharge_eq_ofMoments
statement:
theorem expCharge_eq_ofMoments (S : DivisorSpace D) (P : StabilityParameters D)
    (v : Mukai.RealExtension D) :
    Mukai.expCharge S.intersection P.B P.omega v
      = Exp.ofMoments 2 (tripleMoments S P v)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.expCharge_rankOne_eq_charge
statement:
theorem expCharge_rankOne_eq_charge (S : DivisorSpace D) (H : D) (a b : ℝ)
    (v : Mukai.RealExtension D) :
    Mukai.expCharge S.intersection (StabilityParameters.rankOne H a b).B
        (StabilityParameters.rankOne H a b).omega v
      = Exp.charge 2 (Exp.alphaBetaChart (a, b))
          ![S.pair H H * v.1, S.pair H v.2.1, v.2.2]

statement:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Polarised.hDegrees_zero
statement:
theorem hDegrees_zero (V : NumericalVarietyData n A N) (P : Polarization V.ring)
    (E : N) :

      = (V.rank E : ℚ) * V.ring.degree (P.cls ^ n)

    ((slopeH V P E : ℚ) : ℝ)
      = ((V.ring.degree (P.cls ^ n) : ℚ) : ℝ)
          * (hDegrees V P (unitCorr A) n E ⟨1, by omega⟩
              / hDegrees V P (unitCorr A) n E ⟨0, by omega⟩)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Polarised.slopeH_ne_ratio_of_degree_ne_one
statement:
theorem slopeH_ne_ratio_of_degree_ne_one (V : NumericalVarietyData n A N)

    ((slopeH V P E : ℚ) : ℝ)
      ≠ hDegrees V P (unitCorr A) n E ⟨1, by omega⟩
          / hDegrees V P (unitCorr A) n E ⟨0, by omega⟩

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.AbelianHNFiltration.exists_crossIndex
statement:
theorem exists_crossIndex {Z : StabilityFunction A} {E : A}
    (F : AbelianHNFiltration Z E) (β : ℝ) :
    ∃ k ≤ F.n, (∀ j : Fin F.n, j.val < k → β < F.phase j) ∧
      (∀ j : Fin F.n, k ≤ j.val → F.phase j ≤ β)

statement:
theorem exists_shortExact_hnTors_hnFree (hHN : Z.HasHNProperty) (E : A) :

      T ∈ hnTors Z β ∧ Q ∈ hnFree Z β ∧ (ShortComplex.mk i p w).ShortExact

statement:
theorem eulerClass_add_of_exact
    {A₀ B C : ℤ → A}
    (f : ∀ i, A₀ i ⟶ B i) (g : ∀ i, B i ⟶ C i)
    (δ : ∀ i, C i ⟶ A₀ (i + 1))
    (hfg₀ : ∀ i, f i ≫ g i = 0)
    (hgδ₀ : ∀ i, g i ≫ δ i = 0)
    (hδf₀ : ∀ i, δ i ≫ f (i + 1) = 0)
    (hfg : ∀ i, (ShortComplex.mk (f i) (g i) (hfg₀ i)).Exact)
    (hgδ : ∀ i, (ShortComplex.mk (g i) (δ i) (hgδ₀ i)).Exact)
    (hδf : ∀ i, (ShortComplex.mk (δ i) (f (i + 1)) (hδf₀ i)).Exact)
    (hA : HasFiniteNonzeroSupport A₀)
    (hB : HasFiniteNonzeroSupport B)
    (hC : HasFiniteNonzeroSupport C) :
    eulerClass B = eulerClass A₀ + eulerClass C

statement:

    (V₀ : Submodule ℝ V) (Z : V →ₗ[ℝ] W)
    (hV₀ : V₀ ≤ LinearMap.ker Z) (S : I → Set V) :
    HasUniformQuadraticSupportPropertyModulo V₀ Z hV₀ S ↔
      ∃ Q : QuadraticForm ℝ (V ⧸ V₀),
        (∀ i x, x ∈ S i → 0 ≤ Q (V₀.mkQ x)) ∧
        ∀ y : V ⧸ V₀, quotientCharge V₀ Z hV₀ y = 0 →
          y ≠ 0 → Q y < 0

statement:
theorem Q_zero_alpha (β : ℝ) (v : NumClass) :
    Q 0 β v = 4 * (betaTwist β v).deg2 ^ 2
      - 6 * (betaTwist β v).deg1 * (betaTwist β v).deg3

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Threefold.alignmentValue_div_alpha
statement:
theorem alignmentValue_div_alpha (α β : ℝ) (v w : NumClass) :
    reZ α β v * imZ α β w - imZ α β v * reZ α β w =
      α * (reZ α β v * (imZ α β w / α) - (imZ α β v / α) * reZ α β w) ∨ α = 0

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Threefold.chargeFamily_alignmentValue

      reZ p.1 p.2 v * imZ p.1 p.2 w - imZ p.1 p.2 v * reZ p.1 p.2 w
